query: INSERT INTO accounting.provider_credentials (connection_id, tenant_id, book_id, status, refresh_ciphertext, refresh_issued_at, access_ciphertext, access_expires_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) ON CONFLICT (connection_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, refresh_ciphertext = EXCLUDED.refresh_ciphertext, refresh_issued_at = EXCLUDED.refresh_issued_at, access_ciphertext = EXCLUDED.access_ciphertext, access_expires_at = EXCLUDED.access_expires_at, updated_at = now() WHERE accounting.provider_credentials.tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id AND accounting.provider_credentials.book_id = EXCLUDED.book_id
